name: European Commission VIES (VAT Information Exchange System) REST API
tier_rationale: Official European Commission service relaying the member states' VAT registers (A8 trusted); P225 'Official EC service, free; tier trusted'.

reliability.justification: Authoritative member-state VAT registers relayed by the Commission; member-state back-ends are often unavailable (MS_UNAVAILABLE inside HTTP 200), which is 'could not verify', never 'invalid' (P225 cond 3).

vies.title: VIES REST: GET /taxation_customs/vies/rest-api/ms/{CC}/vat/{number} (single lookups of analyst-typed seeds)

terms.quote: Official VIES REST only (ec.europa.eu .../ms/{CC}/vat/{number}). VATComply is dropped: it wraps the same service and its terms are unknown (A1 unknown terms never run; architect). Opt-in (default_enabled=False). Official EC service, free; tier trusted.

vies.notes: Quote: binding council text (P225 cond 2 and 5). Research C0525: always HTTP 200; isValid + userError (VALID / INVALID / INVALID_INPUT / MS_UNAVAILABLE / MS_MAX_CONCURRENT_REQ / TIMEOUT ...). check-status is advisory only (CZ answered while reported Unavailable). No bulk validation: one request per seed, 2 s apart, one at a time (MS_MAX_CONCURRENT_REQ). Batch p3-G10-1.

notes: Owned by batch p3-G10-1 (P225); only the VIES REST paths under ec.europa.eu/taxation_customs/vies/ are used. api.vatcomply.com (C0536) is never called (P225 cond 2) and is not registered.
